text:
maria: Quick sync — we need to lock the docs/SDKs/sample-apps pipeline for the upcoming release. Proposed changelog cutoff: EOD Thu PST. Owners needed for: docs changelog, SDK packaging, sample app smoke, and the final quickstart verification. pinging @ajay @tammy @sam :eyes:

ajay: I can take SDK packaging. plan: create `release/sdk/v1.8-prerelease` branch by tomorrow noon, run packaging smoke, and upload wheels to the internal repo. need the final CHANGELOG bullet from product (one liner). :+1:

tammy: I'll own sample apps smoke. currently 3 sample apps show CI regressions (integration tests). giving a Wed 5pm PST cut for fixes, otherwise we'll doc the known issues. looping in @oliver on flaky e2e tests. :wrench:

sam: I will own docs/changelog and quickstart updates. I need the API param rename doc from eng-runtime (function-calling rename). maria, can you confirm the final param names so I can update snippets?

maria: Confirmed — runtime changed `call_fn` -> `invoke_tool` and `fn_args` -> `tool_args`. Sam, use those exact names in the examples. Also add a one-line note under Breaking Changes.

oliver: On the e2e flake: reproducing locally on `ubuntu-22` image. failing test is `tests/e2e/sample_app_infer.py::test_streaming`. Repro command: ```pytest -k test_streaming -q --maxfail=1 -s``` Suspect timing/timeout; drafting PR oliver/ci/fix-stream-timeouts, will post link when ready.

ajay: Packaging note: the wheel build needs `protobuf<4` pin until we migrate the generated code. I will add that to the release branch and a brief README entry about runtime deps.

tammy: For sample apps, quick triage plan: 1) run smoke harness locally 2) capture failing logs 3) open hotfix PRs per app. If any app needs >2 dev days we mark as post-release patch and include in release notes.

sam: Docs checklist for me: update changelog, quickstart code snippets, update `examples/` snippets to use `invoke_tool`, and run the docs smoke script `scripts/docs/smoke.sh`. If anyone updates examples, please ping me so I re-run link-check.

maria: Ownership summary: ajay -> SDK packaging + wheels; tammy -> sample app smoke + triage; sam -> docs changelog & quickstarts; oliver -> e2e flake fix + CI. I'll coordinate with product for the CHANGELOG bullet.

devex-bot: nightly-build scheduled: release-candidates/1.8 will run at 2024-06-12T06:00Z. Artifacts will appear in `artifacts/release-candidates/1.8/`.

ajay: FYI I might need a brief thumbs-up from security for pinning `protobuf<4` — tagging sec for a fast ack.

tammy: Quick ask — can someone volunteer to verify the sampleapp README updates after I push fixes? small copy edits only.

sam: I can do a pass after tammy pushes.

maria: Thanks all. If anyone hits a blocker, post here and we’ll escalate to a shiproom. Otherwise we reconvene async on Thursday EOD for final signoffs. :calendar: 

(most messages are short/check-in style, will follow up with PR links as they appear)
